title: Lax Enum Deserialization Fall-Through (ENUM_LAX_DESERIALIZATION)
pattern: Matching serialized enum index values and using a default/wildcard pattern-match that silently returns an "Unknown" or default variant without raising a syntax or schema validation error.
why_bad: It silently hides schema drift. If a newer system introduces a new variant (e.g., `Yellow = 4`), the older receiving system will silently convert it to `Unknown` and continue execution, leading to invalid program states without flagging the protocol mismatch.
detection: Look for wildcard matches (`_` or default) in deserialization functions mapping integer/string codes to internal Enum variants, where the default branch does not return an `Err` result.
fix: Return a `Result<Enum, Error>` during enum mapping. Fail fast upon encountering unrecognized tags so that integration drift is immediately identified.
source: *Scott Wlaschin - Domain Modeling made Functional (2017)*, Chapter 11.
